scope: Original verified native frames, packet rows, and cached original PNGs only. Recorded input and pixel differences do not prove causation or timestamp an uncaptured document change.

rgbaComparison.Decoder: Production LiveSessionReader RGBA PNG decoding; read-only Format32bppArgb LockBits, no DrawImage or compositing.
rgbaComparison.Interpretation: Both alpha=0 with different RGB is hidden pixel storage only. Nonzero alpha/color contribution or alpha changes are actual raster differences. These two snapshots cannot determine when or which operation caused a difference.
